cards.card_text: Then the scene shifts, and David calls out, "Lift up your heads, O gates!" I've seen a lot of things in a kitchen, friend, but I have NEVER seen a door get a pep talk.
cards.verse_text: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!

cards.card_text: Then the call to the gates comes again: "Lift up your heads, O gates!
cards.verse_text: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter! Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts—He is the King of Glory. Selah
